title: Seek control states
statement: For each natural number $k$, define the seek-control state type to have states $	ext{observe}$ and $	ext{done}$, states $	ext{advance}(r)$ and $	ext{state}(r)$ for each rank $r$ with $0 \le r < 3^{k+1}$, and states $	ext{request}(r,s,b)$ for ranks $r,s$ in that range and a Boolean $b$.
